comparison.objective: Align and seat a swinging tapered ball stud; candidate adjusts and validates a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained alignment and forceful tapered insertion versus recessed set-screw tool use, fine collar rotation and iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Stud seated within depth, axis and stillness tolerances versus two safe impacts inside stroke, energy and retention limits.
comparison.reason: Insertion seating is not adjustment or dynamic commissioning. No material rubric detail is missing.
